hook.text: Melted ice cream tastes sickeningly sweet. Frozen, it's perfect. Cold suppresses sweetness perception by up to 50%.

buildup.text: Temperature affects how volatile compounds evaporate. Hot food releases more aromas.

discovery.text: Temperature and Flavor reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Beer is served cold partly to mask off-flavors. Warm beer reveals flaws hidden by cold temperatures.

climax.text: Temperature and Flavor matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: Temperature is a flavor dial. Cold hides sweetness. Heat releases aroma.

quiz.question: Why does melted ice cream taste too sweet?
options: Cold suppresses sweetness perception—warm ice cream reveals its full sugar content
